title: RAG Retrieval & Indexing Pipeline
description: Details document chunking, embedding generation, vector indexing, retrieval filtering, and prompt grounding.
purpose: Provide in-depth architectural and operational blueprint for Retrieval-Augmented Generation.

include_when: The project involves semantic search, vector database retrieval, or knowledge base grounding with an LLM.
exclude_when: Non-AI projects or standard fine-tuning/prompting without retrieval.

instructions: Explain document ingestion, chunk size, overlap, and vector embedding strategy.
Specify the similarity metric and indexing algorithm.
Detail the context injection and hallucination guardrail mechanisms.

content_structure.purpose: Overview of the retrieval and grounding architecture.
Detailed parameters for chunking, embedding, vector search, and reranking.

title: Data Migration Strategy & Reconciliation
description: Outlines source-to-target schema mapping, transformation logic, cutover strategy, and validation checks.
purpose: Define how legacy data is extracted, cleaned, migrated, and verified.

include_when: The project involves database upgrades, cloud data migration, or legacy data transformation.
exclude_when: Greenfield applications with no legacy datasets.

instructions: Document schema mapping and data type transformations.
Specify validation reconciliation checks (row counts, checksums, foreign key integrity).
Detail fallback and rollback contingency procedures.

content_structure.purpose: Structured stages for extraction, transformation, load, and verification.

title: System Integration & API Specifications
description: Defines endpoints, protocols, authentication, and payload formats for connecting external systems.
purpose: Document integration touchpoints, contracts, and error recovery policies.

include_when: The POC must integrate with external ERP, CRM, third-party APIs, or webhooks.
exclude_when: Self-contained standalone systems with no external API contracts.

instructions: Identify each external system and integration protocol (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Webhooks).
Describe authentication handshakes and security token lifecycles.
Define error handling, timeout, and retry circuit breaker rules.
